description: Production badge bundle derived 1:1 from public-reference.v1.json (R12I-A). 53 real badges with official names/categories and cross-checked four-tier unlock requirements. Token cost values are not published by 2K: this bundle carries no cost numbers (gap statement preserved in badge_token.cost.matrix_status).

records.notes: O2 publishes the full 53-badge roster with [NEW] markers; this supersedes C6/C7 reveal-era claim that only 3 new badges were named.
C1 x C4 full-table programmatic diff summary; details in bundle summary conflict table.

GAP STATEMENT: no public source publishes the Badge Token cost matrix (position x height x discipline x badge x tier). C1/C2 are badge unlock requirements, not token costs. All badge_token.cost.* values are null by design; filling them from community rumor tables is forbidden. Matrix must wait for HQ App manual collection (requires Peng Chai approval) before any frozen upgrade.

records.value: Badges carry token costs that vary with height, position and build size; the Builder recalculates cost live, so a loadout is a budget of tokens rather than a fixed sheet.
records.notes: C7 (timesaver.gg) editorial restates the official O2 mechanism. COMMERCIAL-SOURCE CAVEAT: timesaver.gg sells boosting/services; used here only as a cross-echo of official text, never as a source of numeric values. Do not link its service pages.
